description: Origin airport code for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Used as part of the route-level grouping key
notes_or_concerns: Forms the route key together with dest; only the three New York City airports (EWR, JFK, LGA)

description: Destination airport code for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Used as part of the route-level grouping key
notes_or_concerns: Includes one unusual route, EWR to LGA, with a single cancelled flight

description: Number of flights observed for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Count of flight records grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Includes cancelled flights; ranges from 1 to 11,262; 10 routes have fewer than 10 flights, so their averages are unstable

description: Average departure delay for flights on the route, in minutes
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of dep_delay grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Missing for EWR to LGA (its only flight was cancelled); measured on the same flights as the target, so not known before the season and must not be used as a predictor (correlation 0.83 with avg_arr_delay)

description: Average arrival delay for flights on the route, in minutes (target)
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of arr_delay grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Averages only flights with a recorded arrival delay; missing for EWR to LGA (its only flight was cancelled); negative means early on average

description: Maximum arrival delay in minutes for flights on the route.
transformation_or_derivation: Maximum of recorded arrival delays, grouped by origin and dest.
notes_or_concerns: Negative values are possible when all recorded flights arrived early; routes with few flights have less reliable maximums.

description: Average flight distance in miles for the route.
transformation_or_derivation: Mean flight distance, grouped by origin and dest.
notes_or_concerns: Based on recorded flight distances; missing values are excluded from the mean.

description: Average flight time in minutes for the route.
transformation_or_derivation: Mean air time, grouped by origin and dest.
notes_or_concerns: Based on recorded air times; missing values are excluded from the mean.

description: Full name of the destination airport
transformation_or_derivation: Joined from airports using dest = faa
notes_or_concerns: Missing for 7 routes whose destination (BQN, PSE, SJU, STT) is not in the airports table

transformation_or_derivation: Joined from airports using dest = faa.
notes_or_concerns: Missing when destination airport information is unavailable.

notes_or_concerns: Missing when destination airport information is unavailable.
